ruling.explanation:
Rider's claim is upheld in part; SGD 5.70 of the charge is returned.

The deviation. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02828 measures the trip at 14.4 km over 114 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage and no gaps, so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c) and the excess may be measured on it directly. Under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs over the trip record's rounded copy (both read 14.4 km). Against the booked optimal of 9.0 km (EV-TRIP-02828) the excess is 5.4 km, which is 60.0% of optimal: above the 20% and 0.8 km establishment tests, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED, and above the 50% gate, so it is MATERIAL.

POL-RD-06 driver check. On the citable fields, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 2 and completed_trips_90d is 180: the ratio 0.011 is below 0.05 and the count is below 3, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established. No FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral follow.

The fare. The trip is METERED on EV-FARE-02828, so POL-RD-02 governs. Recomputed fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 9.0 + 0.28 x 13.0) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP + 0.00 surcharges + 0.00 waiting - 0.00 promo = 14.19 + 0.80 = 14.99. The surge multiplier 1.0 is the fare_breakdown field, not the trip_record. Charged total was 20.66. Refund = 20.66 - 14.99 = 5.67, above the 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share (27.4%), so the payable figure rounds up to SGD 5.70 on a PARTIAL_REFUND.

Other grounds. EV-FARE-02828 carries zero ERP/toll lines and no airport surcharge, so there is nothing to correct under POL-RD-09. The chat log EV-CHAT-02828 holds zero messages, so no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04. No pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded, so POL-RD-05 does not apply, and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not pooled, so POL-RD-12 does not apply; the 9.0 km booked optimal stands as the baseline. On the driver's stated cause, 'Road works', no traffic advisory covers this trip (EV-ADVIS-02828-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the assertion neither reduces the excess nor supplies an amended route.

The rider's POL-RD-08 burden is discharged on matching identifiers and timestamps, and the rider's profile counters (1 claim) do not raise the corroboration gate. The monetary effect of SGD 5.70 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so the refund executes automatically on issue, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04. Confidence is capped at 1.0: the deciding facts are carried by EV-GPS-02828, EV-TRIP-02828 and EV-FARE-02828, each at weight 1.0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
